in_scope: consensus layer: fork choice, attestation / sync-committee / slashing processing, block and payload validation, gossip and req/resp handling
execution layer: EVM and precompiles, gas accounting, transaction pool, block processing and state, engine API, sync and database
resource exhaustion and denial-of-service reachable from a peer, a transaction or an RPC/engine call
arithmetic and serialization faults that break consensus, cause a chain split or a client crash
out_of_scope: liveness / performance degradation without safety, availability or fund-integrity impact
issues that need local access or a compromised operator
x_note: Sample full-node scope for the ethereum-vuln-dataset track (theorem_map_ethvuln.json): its 66 Critical/High entries span BOTH layers (bug_bounty_area consensus/* and execution/*), so this fixture names both, unlike the consensus-only bug_bounty_scope.sample.json (gasper) and the execution-only bug_bounty_scope.ethtotal.sample.json (EthTotal). The real BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json comes from the speca run; this fixture exists so emit-01e and the tests can run without one.
